description_en: Queries the hotspot annotation configuration for post-processing
description_zh: 查询热点标注配置,后处理时使用
name: GetHotspotConfig

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable access to self-used resources. This must be enabled before publishing the scenario
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自用资源访问（需要在发布场景之前开启）
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The custom Object Storage Service (OSS) domain name. This can be a Content Delivery Network (CDN) domain name
parameters.name: domain

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The authentication diagnostic details returned when permission verification fails. This includes the authentication principal, action, policy, and denial reason
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 权限校验失败时返回的鉴权诊断详情，包含鉴权主体、操作、策略和拒绝原因

AuthAction.description_en: The authentication action that triggers the permission denied error. You can use this to troubleshoot or grant the required permissions
AuthAction.description_zh: 触发无权限错误的鉴权操作，可用于排查或授予所需权限

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The identity identifier of the authentication principal. The display format varies for Resource Access Management (RAM) users, RAM roles, and Single Sign-On (SSO) federated identities
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份标识；RAM 用户、RAM 角色和 SSO 联合身份的展示形式不同

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the authentication principal belongs
AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_zh: 鉴权主体所属阿里云账号的 UID

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The identity type of the authentication principal, such as a RAM user, RAM role, or SSO federated identity
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份类型，例如 RAM 用户、RAM 角色或 SSO 联合身份

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_en: The encoded diagnostic message for the permission denied error. An account administrator with the required permissions can decode this message to troubleshoot the denial reason
EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 无权限错误的编码诊断信息，可交由具备权限的账号管理员解码以排查拒绝原因

NoPermissionType.description_en: The type of the permission denial reason, which distinguishes between implicit denial and explicit denial
NoPermissionType.description_zh: 无权限原因类型，区分未被显式授权和被显式拒绝

PolicyType.description_en: The type of the policy that causes the permission denial, such as a control policy, session policy, or identity-based policy
PolicyType.description_zh: 导致无权限的策略类型，例如管控策略、会话策略或基于身份的策略

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
